- Status after BP-P18-70 (2026-11-10; what was built is in Appendix C, "P18-70 built"; every row has a layout test that failed on caa448d and passes now, except where it says otherwise):
  - Fixed in the BP-P18-70 commit: L01, L02, L03, L04 (typing mode follows the soft keyboard, set by the page from the visual viewport; effectively it helps in landscape only, because the layout viewport does not shrink on current phones and the panel stays under the keyboard in portrait; the 390 x 464 case of its test models a page that shrinks, which current phones do not produce by default; a real keyboard not run), L05, L06, L07, L08, L09, L10, L11, L12, L13, L14, L15 (the pad is at most 30 % of the height and the list no longer jumps after a drag; a finger that starts on the pad still moves the dot, by design), L16 (the cap has a height term too, so the creator keeps its list at 1.5), L17, L18 (the II button is under the bars; it can still sit on the held-item line of the right block), L19 (the touch labels stay 9.9 px by decision), L20, L23 (pinch zoom stays off; the width cap makes UI scale 1.5 safe).
  - Partly: L21 (the portrait mode line may take three lines; the right-hand name `CPU ENE...` is still cut by its ellipsis).
  - Still open: L22 (the first-fight tips card over the picture: Low, shows once, a tap closes it; the text is already at the 12 px floor, so "smaller" is not possible and where it should go is an owner design decision).
- Checked and fine: main menu, modes, Free Fight first screen and More options, Level select, Unlocks, Online screens and the Replace question have no failing measurement at the four sizes (the online lobby layout already has its own test, P12-06); the touch buttons are 58 px (46 px for the small ones) with the stick 130 px or more, none overlaps another, none leaves the screen; the safe-area insets are applied to `.screen`, `#hud` and `#touch`; the creator's touch scroll (a swipe on a row moves the list 105 px per swipe) and the picture's turn by a swipe on the free strip work; no page error appeared at any size.
- Not captured, and why: a real soft keyboard (the viewport was cut to its height instead; iOS keeps the layout height and scrolls, which is not emulated); the height of a real browser bar (844x340 stands for it); iPhone notch and home-bar insets (no emulation of `env(safe-area-inset-*)`); the touch buttons at 1280x720 (a mouse run has none; the 768x1024 and 390x844 runs cover them); the Free Fight HUD with two touch players (not possible on one screen); the online lobby with connected guests (P12-06's own test covers it); the cutscene choice buttons, the error screen, the F3 diagnostics box, toasts and the "waiting for the other player" strip; gamepad and keyboard navigation (not touched by this audit).
- Evidence and method: the scratch scripts (`shoot2.mjs`, `inpage.js`, `touchtest.mjs`, `chrome-heights.mjs`) and the results are in the scratch folder above; they are not kept in the repo. Re-running them needs a copy of the game with the one added line and `playwright-core` from the npx cache.

### P18-77 z-fighting and rendering artifacts on the 8 levels (2026-11-12)

- Owner, 2026-11-12 18:46: "There are various parts in the levels where z fighting and similar glitching artifacts occur." Audit and fix (base `c0e10f0`, branch `bp-p18-77-zfight`); the decisions are in Appendix C "P18-77 z-fighting and rendering artifacts on the 8 levels, decided".
- Method (scripts and shots are in the scratch folder `C:\Users\GS\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\bp77\` with `scripts\`, `before\` and `after\`; not kept in the repo): (1) the code was read for every place that draws near the floor or near another surface (the clip planes, the depth settings, the planar shadow pass, the floor decals, decks, stairs, props, wall dressing, the batches and the transparent layer and its order); (2) depth ties on the GPU (Chrome, an RTX 2060 Super, 24-bit depth, 4x MSAA): the game is served with one extra line (`globalThis.__ev`) so a probe can draw a level itself; every level, in 1v1 and in brawl framing, from 15 spots with the game's own camera and from orbit eyes (3 distances, 3 heights, 12 directions, those that stay near the room), 896 views at each of 1280x720, 844x390 and 390x844 and at the Low preset; each frame is drawn with the depth test LEQUAL, again LEQUAL (pixels that change by themselves are dropped) and with LESS: a pixel whose colour changes between LEQUAL and LESS is a depth tie, two surfaces at one depth. A 24x24 px cell with 60 or more tie pixels is a flickering area; thinner marks are where two surfaces cross (the strap of a crate through its top: not an artifact); (3) the same in geometry: every draw call of a level recorded, each box or cylinder cap taken as a flat polygon, the pairs that face one way within 2 mm over more than 0.0002 m2 (0.004 m2 for a parked weapon) with a different colour, layer or light and a clear ray from some eye of the fight cameras (36 eye points, up to 17 m high) listed (this is the self-test); (4) the depth range: a 48x27 grid of rays from every fight camera against the boxes and the floor; (5) transparency order: each frame against itself with every alpha batch reversed.
- Depth range of the fight cameras (8 levels, 15 spots, 1v1 and brawl): nearest 0.95 m, farthest 34.1 m at 1280x720; 0.75 and 34.1 m at 844x390; 2.27 and 42.7 m at 390x844 (a phone held upright pulls the camera back to 14.4 to 21 m and up to 12 m high). A 24-bit depth step there: with near 0.3 and far 120, 0.37 mm at 43 m; with 0.5 and 80, 0.22 mm.
- Result: views with a flickering area at 1280x720 / 390x844 / 844x390 / Low 1280x720 / Low 390x844: 280 / 150 / 165 / 150 / 90 of 896 before (383,641 / 115,017 / 79,549 / 98,065 / 28,301 tie pixels in those cells, 120 / 34 / 51 / 39 / 16 distinct spots), 0 in every set after. The geometry list went from 303 pairs to none (self-test "Z-fighting (P18-77)", on c0e10f0). Review round: the test also runs on the Low preset (the plain looks), its area floor is 0.0002 m2 (0.0005 let the 0.03 x 0.008 m ends of the deck board gaps tie with the lip through), the board gaps stop 0.01 m short of each end of the plate, and the 15 wall ribs of the Subway stop 0.02 m under the wall top (their top faces shared a plane with the wall's over a 5 mm strip).

- Seen, measured and left as they are: crossing lines (two surfaces that meet, a strap through a crate top, a weapon on an item ring) give a thin tie mark and no artifact; transparency order (each frame against itself with every alpha batch reversed, 240 fight views at 1280x720: no view changes more than 8 pixels by more than 60 of 765, the order is the push order and never changes between frames: no pop); the weapon models (two parked items can share a 0.002 m2 face), the fighter bodies (a 1.3 mm pair on the torso, 0.004 m2) and the binary fade of the hanging load (Appendix C lists them); the planar shadows (plane 0.012 m up with `polygonOffset(-2, -2)`) and the floor decals (0.009 to 0.02 m up) are at least 40 depth steps clear at 43 m: no acne, no floating shadow and no decal flicker was found in the 896 views; the noise on rough surfaces is a 0.125 m cell, 2.5 px at the farthest wall: resolved, no shimmer found.
- Not captured, and why: a phone GPU (the measurements are from an RTX 2060 Super with a 24-bit depth buffer; a 16-bit buffer has 0.056 m steps at 43 m (near 0.5, far 80), and is on the P16-03 list); the Low preset on a phone's own GPU.
